definitions.short: probably a (black) tile (or tessara) for laying borders with
definitions.full: H5508. sochereth [ סֹחֶ֫רֶת ] noun feminine a stone used (with marble) in paving (compare Assyrian si—ru , a precious stone, Dl HWB 495 ); — סֹחָ֑רֶת Est 1:6 .

occurrences.englishText: There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. The couches were of gold and silver, on a pavement of red, white, yellow, and black marble.
